_about: What each short link is for, so the team page (team-links/, scripts/build-editor-lists.py) can find offers by topic: its search bar ('budget' -> Simplifi, Quicken ...) and the new-video box (a title with no tool name but a topic, e.g. 'How to Create a Budget From Scratch', gets the offers that fit as suggestions to pick by hand). Kevin, 29 Oct: 'the editor then has field where he types in budget and/or budgeting and get the list of all affiliate offers that fit'. 'offers': slug -> topics; '@name' is a set from 'sets'. Topics are whole words or phrases matched in titles (a plural 's'/'es' on the last word also counts), so keep them specific: 'create a budget', not 'budget' (a 'budget phone' is a cheap phone). A link without an entry is found only by its name. New link: add its topics here, then python3 scripts/build-editor-lists.py.
